data.taxBenefit: Eligible for Beckham Law special tax regime with a flat 24% tax rate on Spanish-sourced income up to EUR 600,000.
requirements: Minimum monthly income of 200% of Spanish minimum wage (EUR 2,646/month)
Proof of remote employment or self-employment with non-Spanish entities for at least 3 months
Clean criminal record certificate from countries of residence for the past 5 years
Full private health insurance policy operating in Spain

data.taxBenefit: 0% personal income tax on foreign-sourced income for UAE residents.
requirements: Proof of employment with a contract valid for at least 1 year or proof of business ownership
Minimum monthly income of $3,500 USD (or equivalent)
Passport valid for at least 6 months
Valid health insurance coverage for the UAE

data.taxBenefit: Eligible for specific tax incentives under the IFICI regime for qualified professionals
requirements: Proof of monthly income equal to or greater than 4 times the Portuguese minimum wage
Proof of employment, freelance contract, or business ownership outside Portugal
Proof of long-term accommodation in Portugal
Valid health insurance and clean criminal record certificate

data.taxBenefit: Exempt from local income tax on foreign-sourced income for the 6-month duration
requirements: Minimum annual income of JPY 10,000,000 (approx. 833,333 JPY/month)
Citizenship of one of the 49 eligible tax-treaty and visa-exempt countries
Private health insurance with coverage for injury, illness, and death during the entire stay
Remote work conducted for an employer or clients located outside Japan

data.taxBenefit: Tax residency applies after 183 days of stay; taxation on foreign income depends on applicable double taxation treaties.
requirements: Proof of location-independent remote work using telecommunications technology
Minimum gross monthly income of EUR 4,500 for the preceding 6 months
Employment contract with a foreign company, or ownership of a foreign-registered business

data.taxBenefit: Exempt from personal income tax on foreign-sourced income while residing in Croatia.
requirements: Must be a third-country national working remotely via technology for a non-Croatian employer or own company
Minimum monthly income requirement or proof of sufficient funds in bank account
Valid travel document valid at least 3 months past intended stay
Proof of private or travel health insurance covering Croatia

data.stayDuration: 3 to 12 months (Renewable up to 12 additional months)
data.taxBenefit: Foreign-sourced income from foreign clients or employers is exempt from Malaysian personal income tax.
requirements: Minimum monthly income of USD 2,000 (USD 24,000 annually)
Proof of remote employment, freelance contracts, or company ownership with non-Malaysian clients
Passport valid for at least 14 months
Valid health insurance covering Malaysia

data.taxBenefit: 50% tax exemption on income above TWD 3 million for up to 5 years
requirements: Minimum monthly income of TWD 160,000 in a qualifying field
Demonstrated expertise in one of 10 specified sectors (Tech, Science, Economy, etc.)
Valid passport with at least 6 months validity

data.taxBenefit: Foreign-sourced income is exempt from Thai personal income tax if not remitted into Thailand during the same tax year.
requirements: At least 20 years of age
Proof of financial support of at least 500,000 THB in savings
Proof of remote employment, freelancing, or participation in approved Thai cultural/medical activities

data.taxBenefit: 50% reduction on personal income tax for up to 7 years for digital nomads transferring tax residence to Greece.
requirements: Proof of remote work for foreign employers, clients, or foreign-registered business
Minimum net monthly income of EUR 3,500 (plus 20% for spouse, 15% per dependent child)
Comprehensive health insurance valid in Greece
Clean criminal record certificate from home country

data.taxBenefit: Tax exemption on foreign dividends and interest for up to 17 years under the non-domiciled tax regime.
requirements: Proof of minimum monthly net income of EUR 3,500 from sources outside Cyprus.
Employment contract or business ownership documents for remote work serving non-Cyprus clients.
Valid passport, clean criminal background check, health insurance, and Cyprus rental agreement.

data.taxBenefit: Exempt from local income tax as stay is capped at 180 days within 12 months
requirements: Proof of monthly income of at least 1,000,000 ISK (1,300,000 ISK if accompanied by spouse)
Proof of remote employment with a foreign employer or foreign self-employment
Comprehensive health insurance covering Iceland
Non-EEA/EFTA citizenship with visa-free travel privileges to the Schengen area

data.taxBenefit: Svalbard applies a low flat income tax rate (approx. 8-12%) instead of mainland Norwegian taxes.
requirements: Proof of self-sufficiency and sufficient funds to cover living expenses in Svalbard
Confirmed housing accommodation in Svalbard prior to arrival
Valid passport and comprehensive health insurance
Schengen transit visa if traveling through mainland Norway

data.taxBenefit: Access to the flat-rate tax scheme (paušální daň) unifying income tax, health, and social security payments.
requirements: Proof of funds equivalent to at least 156,500 CZK in a bank account
Obtain a Czech Trade License (Živnostenský list)
Proof of long-term accommodation in the Czech Republic
Clean criminal record certificate and health insurance

data.taxBenefit: Eligible for tax incentives under the Impatriati regime or the Forfettario flat-tax scheme for freelancers.
requirements: Minimum annual remote income of EUR 28,000 (approx. EUR 2,333/month)
Comprehensive health insurance valid in Italy for the entire duration of stay
Proof of suitable accommodation/housing in Italy
At least 6 months of documented prior experience as a remote worker or freelancer

data.taxBenefit: Exemption from personal income tax, social security, and health insurance contributions for non-residents staying up to 183 days
requirements: Proof of remote employment or foreign company ownership for at least 3 months prior to application
Proof of monthly income of at least 3x Romania gross average salary (~EUR 3,700) for the preceding 6 months
Valid health insurance covering the entire stay in Romania
Clean criminal record certificate issued by country of origin or residence

data.taxBenefit: No personal income tax or capital gains tax on foreign income.
requirements: Proof of employment or business ownership outside Bermuda
Demonstrate a continuous source of annual income or sufficient financial means
Valid health insurance coverage for the duration of stay
Clean criminal record

data.taxBenefit: No personal income tax, capital gains tax, or tax on foreign income for remote workers in The Bahamas.
requirements: Valid passport with at least 6 months remaining validity
Proof of remote employment, freelancing, or business ownership outside The Bahamas
Proof of valid health insurance covering medical expenses in The Bahamas
Proof of sufficient funds to support yourself during the stay

data.taxBenefit: Complete exemption from Costa Rican personal income tax on foreign earnings and duty-free import of personal work equipment.
requirements: Proof of stable monthly remote income of at least $3,000 USD for individuals ($4,000 USD for families) over the past 12 months
Proof of remote work or self-employment with entities located outside Costa Rica
Private health insurance coverage for the total duration of stay in Costa Rica

data.taxBenefit: Tax resident status begins only after spending 183 continuous days in Brazil within a 12-month period.
requirements: Proof of remote work for an employer or clients located outside Brazil
Minimum monthly foreign income of $1,500 or bank balance of $18,000
Valid health insurance coverage in Brazil
Clean criminal record certificate from home country

data.stayDuration: 180 Days (Renewable once for up to 180 Days)
data.taxBenefit: Foreign-sourced income is exempt from local personal income tax during the temporary residency period.
requirements: Proof of remote employment, freelancing, or corporate ownership outside Argentina
Curriculum Vitae detailing professional work experience
Valid passport with at least six months validity
Comprehensive health insurance covering emergency medical care in Argentina

data.taxBenefit: Foreign-sourced income is not subject to Mauritian tax if it is not remitted into Mauritius.
requirements: Proof of monthly income of at least USD 1,500 from foreign sources
Valid travel and health insurance covering the stay duration
Proof of accommodation in Mauritius
Valid passport and return flight ticket

data.taxBenefit: Exemption from local personal income tax on foreign-sourced income
requirements: Proof of remote employment or business ownership outside Seychelles
Proof of sufficient funds or income
Valid travel and health insurance covering Seychelles
Valid passport for the duration of stay

data.taxBenefit: Foreign remote workers spending fewer than 183 days in a 12-month period are exempt from South African personal income tax.
requirements: Proof of remote employment with a foreign employer or foreign business ownership
Minimum gross annual income of ZAR 650,000 (approx. ZAR 54,167 monthly)
Comprehensive health insurance covering the duration of stay in South Africa
Valid passport and clean criminal record certificate
